reasons: All five preferred atomic elements are present in operative text: affiliate and contractor scope in the grant, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licences, termination of subscription licences only for uncured material breach, and a successor-transfer carve-out in §15.
Edits are surgical: one phrase insertion into the grant, one short new sentence after the term provision, and a short carve-out appended to §15 — no whole-clause rewrite or boilerplate.

Untouched commercial terms (non-exclusivity, permitted-use field, Client's freedom to use alternative software, mutual consent requirement for assignment) remain fully effective; no undefined terms introduced.

Minor drafting note only (not a deviation): §c still reads "The license shall last until this Agreement is terminated," so the new perpetual-licence sentence would read more cleanly with a "Notwithstanding the foregoing" lead-in to remove any residual tension.
Contractor scope carries no flow-down/compliance qualifier, which is favourable to us and therefore not flagged.
